build_get_binary_op_configs: build binary operator configs for add, mul, and matmul with ReLU fusion patterns and dtype constraints
build_get_linear_configs: build linear module and fused linear-relu, linear-batchnorm config patterns for quantization
build_get_conv_configs: build conv1d/2d/3d module configs with relu and batchnorm fusion patterns for quantization
build_get_fixed_qparams_op_configs: build operator configs for sigmoid, tanh, and hardsigmoid with fixed quantization parameter constraints
build_get_share_qparams_op_configs: build operator configs for avgpool, maxpool, reshape, transpose, and relu that share quantization params with input
